auth.code.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a 6-digit sign-in code.
auth.code.sent_to: If {{email}} has an account, we've sent it a 6-digit code. The code is valid for 10 minutes.
auth.code.label: Sign-in code
auth.error.invalid_email_code: The code is wrong or has expired. You can request a new one.
auth.error.account_deactivated: This account was deleted and can no longer be used. If you think this is a mistake, contact our support team.
auth.error.account_disabled: This account has been disabled by an administrator.
auth.error.rate_limited_seconds: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
auth.error.rate_limited_minutes: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
auth.error.invalid_id_token: We couldn't verify your {{provider}} sign-in. Please try again.
auth.error.provider_disabled: Sign in with {{provider}} isn't available right now.
auth.error.provider_unavailable: Sign in with {{provider}} isn't available on this device.
auth.error.invalid_link_ticket: This step has expired. Please sign in with {{provider}} again.
auth.error.link_conflict: This {{provider}} account is linked to another account, or your account already has a {{provider}} sign-in.
auth.error.registration_closed: New accounts can't be created right now.
auth.not_linked.title: Your {{provider}} account isn't linked
auth.not_linked.body: An Otopoly account already uses this email, but your {{provider}} account isn't linked to it. Sign in the usual way (password or email code), then link {{provider}} under Profile → Linked accounts. We'll take you there once you're signed in.
auth.not_linked.use_code: Sign in with an email code
auth.link.title: Do you have an account?
auth.link.body: You chose to hide your email when signing in with Apple. If you already have an Otopoly account, we'll link Sign in with Apple to it. Otherwise we'll create a new account for you.
auth.link.no_register: New accounts can't be created right now. You can link an existing account.
auth.link.email_hint: Enter the email you use for Otopoly. If it has an account, we'll send a verification code to it.
auth.demo.code_hint: Demo email code: {{code}} (demo@, personel@, ali@). Other codes are on the Diagnostics screen.
auth.demo.choose_hint: In demo mode a sample identity is used instead of a real {{provider}} sign-in.
auth.demo.apple_relay: Apple: new user with hidden email
auth.delete.row_subtitle: Close your account and end every session
auth.delete.title: Delete my account
auth.delete.point_closed: Your account is closed and can't be used again. Signing in with a password, email code, Apple or Google stops working.
auth.delete.point_sessions: You're signed out on every device. If you used Sign in with Apple, the app's Apple permission is revoked too.
auth.delete.point_data: Records tied to your account are kept as required by law (for example tax and commercial record-keeping obligations).
auth.delete.point_org: Businesses you own and their data aren't deleted. Other users in the business can keep working.
auth.delete.code_hint: To confirm, we'll send a 6-digit code to {{email}}.
auth.delete.code_sent: We've sent the code to {{email}}. It's valid for 10 minutes.
auth.delete.confirm_body: This can't be undone. Your account will be closed and you'll be signed out.
auth.delete.done: Your account was deleted and you've been signed out.
auth.delete.step_up: Security check required. Request a new confirmation code.
auth.delete.conflict: This account can't be deleted right now. Please contact our support team.
